subject: applied-maths
summary: Applied Maths cards show only the last sentence of each question as text, under the paper's general instruction about g and unit vectors, so the card alone cannot be answered: 'Find the value of h', 'Find |PQ|', 'Write the adjacency matrix for this graph' appear with no ball, river, or graph. The setup and diagram sit one tap away in the attached page, which is cropped to the right question and is clear, though it shows every sibling part. The revealed scheme is a stack of identical boxes labelled 'Published step 1 · 5 marks' with 0/2/5 buttons and two error counters; in eleven of the twelve desktop captures and all phone captures the scheme lines for each step are absent, a 10px unreadable strip, or stuck on 'Loading the step…', so no answer is visible. Only card 5 on desktop shows what the design intends: the official scheme lines inside each step, which is good. Vector notation is broken: the arrows on i and j render as box glyphs in the stem and as blank gaps in the question.

issues.title: Question text has no setup; card cannot be answered as shown
issues.detail: The card prints the paper's general instruction ('Take the value of g to be 9.8 m s⁻²...') as if it were the question's context, then only the final sub-part sentence. The scenario, given values and diagram are missing: card 11 is just 'Find the value of h.'; card 2 'Find |PQ|, the distance from P to Q.'; card 3 'Find, in terms of I, m and r, the tension in the string.'; card 6 'Write the adjacency matrix for this graph.' with no graph; card 8 refers to 'the cyclist'; card 4 and 9 to 'the system' and 'each sphere'. Every card requires opening the attached page to know what is being asked.
issues.suggested_fix: Show the cropped question region (stem, diagram and this part) inline on the card, as Maths does, or put the real stem text and diagram above the part. Move the general g / unit-vector instruction to a small footnote.

issues.title: Revealed scheme shows no scheme content
issues.detail: After the reveal the card says 'Each step shows the scheme's own lines for it' but the step boxes contain only 0/2/5 buttons and 'Mathematical errors (−3 each)' / 'Slips (−1 each)' counters. Steps are named 'Published step 1', 'Published step 2'... with no description of what the step is. On desktop 11 of 12 cards show no scheme lines; on the phone none are readable. A 25-mark question (card 3) becomes five identical empty boxes. The student cannot see the answer or decide which step they earned.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the scheme-line crop for each step load reliably and reserve its height before the buttons (card 5 desktop shows it working). Give each step a plain title from the scheme (e.g. 'Time to highest point', 'Displacement'), and show the full official solution crop inline above the steps.

issues.title: Scheme-line crops collapse to an unreadable strip on phone
issues.detail: Where a step crop does appear on the phone it is squeezed into a strip about 10px high with text around 3px (card 4 step 2 '= 68.75 J', card 9 'equal in magnitude and opposite in direction'). Card 1 shows a permanent 'Loading the step…'. Card 5's step crops, which load on desktop, are absent on the phone.
issues.suggested_fix: Render step crops at natural aspect ratio at full card width, with a minimum text size, and replace the loading text with a fixed-height placeholder. For one-line answers like card 9, just print the line as text.

issues.title: Vector arrows render as box glyphs or blanks
issues.detail: The stem prints 'i▯ and j▯ are perpendicular unit vectors' with missing-glyph boxes after i and j (cards 2, 5, 6, 8). In card 5's question the arrows vanish, leaving 'in terms of i   and j  .' with odd gaps before the full stop.
issues.suggested_fix: Use a font that has the combining arrow, or render vectors as bold i and j / with proper maths markup.

issues.title: Flattened maths in the question line
issues.detail: Card 1 prints 'u² sin 2α/g', which reads as sin(2α/g) rather than the fraction (u² sin 2α)/g printed on the paper. Card 10 prints 'sin⁻¹(1/5)' with a tiny raised −1 that is hard to see on the phone.
issues.suggested_fix: Render fractions as stacked fractions or show the question crop.

issues.title: Attached page shows all sibling parts and other lettered parts
issues.detail: The attached page is cropped to the whole numbered question, so it shows every part: card 1 (Q3(a)(i)) also shows (a)(ii) and all of (b); card 12 (Q7(a)) also shows all of Q7(b); cards 3, 7, 10 show part (a) proofs and other sub-parts; card 8 opens on part (iii) and its large empty grid before the cyclist text. No different numbered question appears.
issues.suggested_fix: Crop to the lettered part and its stem, or highlight the part asked.

issues.title: Generic marking rules and irrelevant controls
issues.detail: Every card repeats the same paragraph on attempt marks and deductions. Card 9 is an 'Explain' question but still shows 'Mathematical errors' and 'Slips' counters. Card 6's matrix question shows the irrelevant g / unit vector instruction and a one-line scale but not the matrix. The orange '0' button is pre-selected and the footer says 'No SEC allocation placement selected yet', which is jargon.
issues.suggested_fix: Collapse the generic rules behind a 'How marking works' link, hide error counters on non-calculation parts, and reword the footer in plain English.

issues.title: Long labels and empty band
issues.detail: Cards with a nickname repeat it four times (breadcrumb, eyebrow, 'Practise:' line, attachment label), e.g. card 7 'Length of the equivalent simple pendulum'. On the phone an empty band of about 200px sits between the attachment button and 'Your answer'.
issues.suggested_fix: Show the nickname once and drop the fixed minimum height on the question block.
